newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis values unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis values unchanged.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers were unchanged in quiet market activity Thursday, dealers said.
Hard red winter wheat offers slipped seven cents a bushel when dealers switched basis offers to the KCBT July from the May without adjusting for July's discount to May.
Soft red winter wheat's basis values were unchanged.

Export markets were quiet. Japan did not buy wheat in its weekly tender because of a holiday. Results were awaited on Jordan's PL-480 tender Thursday for 120,000 tonnes of hard red winter or dark northern spring wheat for May-June shipment.
